content.comment_body: Is it possible to read or write to the [product_name] directly from [product_name] without using a [product_name]? We only need to send a message triggered by a single event from a script within [product_name], but we want to avoid installing another network socket just to modify a [product_name] value when it could go straight to the [product_name] device. Alternatively, we could connect the [product_name] to a PLC, as we already have several on site. Kind regards, [user_name]
No, the [product_name] is intended to communicate only with a [product_name] basis module.
I thought so. Thanks for your reply! I'll need to purchase additional equipment.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asks about integrating direct communication between [product_name] and [product_name] Communication Modules, specifically a certain device. The community confirms that direct interfacing is not possible since the module is designed to operate only with the basis module. The user acknowledges this restriction and accepts the need for further hardware.
